source.name: Beast Boost
source.originalDescription: When Buzzwole knocks out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 100% and basic attack speed increased by 50% for 3s. When Buzzwole assists in knocking out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 50% and basic attack speed increased by 25% for 3s. Each time Buzzwole hits an enemy with basic attacks, Mega Punch, Lunge, or Smack Down - muscle gauge increases. Conversely, when Buzzwole has been out of combat for 10s, muscle gauge depletes by 1 increment every 5s. Up to 6 muscle gauge increments can be stored.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Beast Boost は 移動速度を上げる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Fell Stinger
source.originalDescription: Consumes the entire muscle gauge and has the user deal damage to an enemy in the designated direction, briefly shoving and stunning them for .2s. The damage dealt by this move increases for each muscle gauge increment consumed at a rate of 12.5% per increment. If this move knocks out any Pokémon, the user recovers 10% of maximum HP.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Fell Stinger は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、与ダメージを変化させる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Ultra Swole Slam
source.originalDescription: Buzzwole flies at high speed, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. Afterward, the user targets the enemy with the lowest percentage of HP remaining among those hit and charges down at them from the sky, dealing area damage once again and additional damage to the targeted enemy based on their missing HP. Buzzwole is Unstoppable during this move. Against Wild Pokemon: Missing HP damage is not dealt. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Ultra Swole Slam は 妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ。
